core_obligations: Use the original intuitionistic propositional provability and relational semantics, not classical maximal consistency.
Preserve arbitrary premise sets under the original countable formula syntax and finite-proof convention.
Prime extensions retain non-derivability of the selected target at every stage.
Each absent implication has a witness extension at a future prefix world; all core construction is retained.
The author leaves the routine negation truth case and elementary exercises unexpanded; no assistant solution is added.
The theorem is completeness only; no first-order, finite-frame or algorithmic decidability conclusion is selected.
proof_roadmap: Extend the original non-derivable theory to a prime one without deriving the target.
Build the finite-sequence world tree and prime-theory extensions for all formula pairs.
Prove the canonical truth lemma including the future witness for implication.
At the root obtain the original theorem by contraposition.
difficulty_reason: H2: the final completeness invocation is supported by a full non-classical countermodel construction. The author builds a prime extension while maintaining non-derivability of a chosen formula, schedules disjunction obligations, and recursively assigns prime theories to a prefix-ordered tree of finite sequences so that every non-derivable implication gets a future-world witness. The implication case of the truth lemma then turns these witnesses into a relational countermodel. This prime-preserving construction and simultaneous future-world control are the nonroutine core; the entire authored construction is supplied, not hidden behind the short final proof.

editorial_notes: All mathematical statement and proof text is reproduced verbatim from the Open Logic Project, unit intuitionistic-logic, file completeness-thm.tex, fixed at commit 1e960beff9ed7835bf3e3f1335e21af3439cd107. Only the packaging (the adapter preamble and the standalone wrapper) is this module's.
Numbering inside this standalone excerpt is editorial, not the Open Logic Project print numbering.

The adapter preamble loads the project's OWN style layer verbatim (sty/open-logic-formulas.sty, sty/open-logic-tokenize.sty, sty/open-logic-selective.sty and open-logic-config.sty, including its tag truth assignment), so the author's !! text-token shorthand, !A math metavariables, rule names (Intro, Elim, FalseInt) and the tag conditionals resolve exactly as in the book. Three substitutions are forced by the pinned toolchain and are recorded: isomath.sty is absent so \mathsfit is \mathsf; xpunctuate.sty is absent and unused so its RequirePackage is dropped; thmtools/ntheorem are absent so the environments are amsthm with the project's family numbering. The proof trees are the project's own bussproofs-extra.

The H2 judgement and its reason were made in this module by reading the author's own statement and complete proof at the pinned line span. Original candidate key: intuitionistic-logic/soundness-completeness|completeness-thm.tex|thm:completeness.

Reference labels in the proof resolve to navigation pointers to the original author source; these pointers do not reproduce proofs of the prerequisites. The author's own ollabel is kept unprefixed (not part:chapter:section) so those pointers resolve; the label text itself is the author's own argument.
